compare.original_normal_scratch: A4=0x40024000; A5=initial saved guard word; A3=last LBU byte when entered, otherwise original A3 unchanged
compare.new_normal_scratch: A5=initial saved guard word; A3=normal boolean result on every exit; A4=last LBU byte when entered, otherwise original A4 unchanged; RA and SP restored only on normal return
compare.original_first_byte_fault_A0: u32(initial address+1), because the original advances A0 before the first LBU using -1(A0)
compare.new_first_byte_fault_A0: initial address, because LBU at selected PC0x1c precedes A0 increment at PC0x26; mismatch also skips that increment
compare.new_prefix: SP-=16 and SW original RA to12(SP) precede guard READ32; RA becomes guard base. New stack faults, alias effects and async observations are possible before original guard effects.

fill.original_normal_scratch: A4=0x40024000; A5=initial saved guard word; A3 and A2 unchanged by every own instruction
fill.new_normal_scratch: A4=0x40024000 on every normal exit (reloaded after nonempty loop); A5=initial saved guard word; A3 unchanged. A2 is used as loop counter and restored from RA at PC0x3c; RA and SP restored only on normal return
fill.original_first_byte_fault_A0: u32(initial destination+1), because original advances A0 before first SB using -1(A0)
fill.new_first_byte_fault_A0: initial destination at SB PC0x2a; incremented value exists in A4 and A0 changes only at PC0x2e
fill.new_prefix: SP-=16 and SW original RA to12(SP) precede guard READ32. A2 changes transiently; end-address spill to8(SP) adds memory effects. A4 no longer stays guard base throughout loop. Restoring normal values does not erase fault/async differences.

copy.original_normal_scratch: A5=0x40024000; A4=initial saved guard word; A3=last destination byte address and A6=last LBU byte when entered, otherwise original A3/A6 unchanged; A0/A1/A2 unchanged by every own instruction
copy.new_normal_scratch: A3=0x40024000 on every normal exit; entered loop leaves A4=u32(destination+count), A5=u32(destination+count), A6=last LBU byte. Skipped loop leaves A4/A5 at their original input scratch values. A0/A1/A2 remain unchanged; RA and SP restored only on normal return
copy.new_prefix: SP-=16 and SW original RA to12(SP) precede guard READ32; RA holds initial guard word through byte loop. New stack faults, alias effects and async RA/SP observations remain possible.
